messages:
Maya R.: Quick sync 30 — noticed lead handoff latency spike overnight. HubSpot enrichment queue backed up, so round-robin assign waits and leaves leads unowned. SLA alerts for unclaimed leads fired. Anyone have context?

Jon P.: Confirmed. ~150 unassigned leads between 02:00-04:00 UTC. Enrichment API retries ballooned due to third-party rate limit. Our workflow currently blocks assignment until enrichment completes.

Sophia M.: This is exactly why we were discussing decoupling assignment. Suggest immediate temp RR assignment + enrichment-based reconciliation only if SDR hasn't touched lead. Avoid owner churn.

Liam O.: We previously tried immediate assign; got churn when enrichment remapped owner after SDR touched. We need reconcile rules: only overwrite owner if last_modified_by == system and last_touch == none. Also track reconciliation events for audits.

Maya R.: Drafting a simple HubSpot workflow and Salesforce sync plan:

- On lead creation: set property temp_owner = RR; set property ack_ts = {{timestamp}}; set property assignment_mode = "temp"; trigger enrichment webhook async.
- If enrichment returns within 5m and lead.touched == false: set owner = enrichment.owner; set assignment_mode = "final"; else leave temp owner.
- If enrichment returns but lead.touched == true: set property reconciliation_needed = true and notify sales-ops channel.
- If ack_ts older than 20s and owner is empty: escalate to oncall.

hubspot-bot: Deployed flow to staging: hs/ack-tempassign-v2. Test payloads recommended.

Jon P.: Add metrics capture: time_to_ack, time_to_temp_assign, time_to_final_assign, percent_unowned_30s, owner_flip_rate. Push these to Looker via BigQuery.

Sophia M.: I'll add SLA language for the marketing playbook: ack <=20s, temp owner <30s, final settle <=5m; owner flips >2% trigger rollback. Also include a template email for SDRs when reconciliation_needed is set.

Liam O.: Running 2k synthetic leads against staging now, will share latency distribution. @Jon P. can we add a rule in SFDC sync that prevents overwriting owner if owner.last_touch != system?

Jon P.: Yes, SFDC sync will respect last_touch and will only update owner when last_touch == null or = "system". We'll also record reconciliation_history property in HubSpot for auditability.

Maya R.: Thanks team. If staging tests good, propose a canary rollout next Wednesday 50% traffic -> 100% in 48h. Sophia, loop sales-ops for acceptance criteria.

Sophia M.: Will do. Adding checklist to the playbook and scheduling a 30m handoff with sales-ops tomorrow.

Liam O.: Test results: 2k leads - 0.8% unowned >30s, avg time_to_temp_assign 12s, avg time_to_final_assign 1m45s. Will tune RR function to spread leads more evenly.

Jon P.: Nice numbers. Let's ship to canary next Wed.
